routes.label: Consider the vertex-angle and base-angle cases

question: One interior angle of an isosceles triangle is \(80^\circ\). What are the possible measures of its vertex angle in degrees? (List all possible values in ascending order, separated by commas.)
solution: If the \(80^\circ\) angle is the vertex angle, the vertex angle is \(80^\circ\). If the \(80^\circ\) angle is a base angle, the vertex angle is \(180^\circ-2\times80^\circ=20^\circ\). Therefore, the vertex angle is \(20^\circ\) or \(80^\circ\).
